GMMHMM.export_analysis_results(model_info, data_cleaning_info, feature_keys, feature_weights, model_path, raw_averages=None)[source]

Export the model analysis results and data cleaning information to a JSON file.

Parameters:

  • model_info (dict) – Dictionary containing model analysis information

  • data_cleaning_info (dict) – Dictionary containing data cleaning information

  • feature_keys (list) – List of feature names used in the model

  • feature_weights (dict) – Dictionary of feature weights

  • model_path (str) – Path to the saved model (used to generate output filename)

  • raw_averages (dict, optional) – Dictionary containing raw feature averages by label

Returns:

Path to the exported file

Return type:

str

GMMHMM.prepare_multi_feature_data(all_track_data_with_filenames)[source]

Processes loaded track data to extract multiple features defined in FEATURE_KEYS, scales them, applies weights, determines states, and prepares for HMM training. Includes detailed debugging prints for features.

GMMHMM.train_gmmhmm(X, lengths, n_states, n_mix, min_covar, transmat_prior=None)[source]

Trains a GMMHMM model on the prepared multi-feature data.

Parameters:

  • X (np.ndarray) – The scaled and weighted multi-feature data (n_observations, n_features).

  • lengths (list) – List of sequence lengths.

  • n_states (int) – The number of hidden states (labels).

  • n_mix (int) – The number of Gaussian mixtures per state.

  • min_covar (float) – Minimum covariance value for regularization.

  • transmat_prior (np.ndarray, optional) – Pre-calculated transition matrix to initialize with.

Returns:

The trained GMMHMM model, or None if training fails.

Return type:

hmm.GMMHMM

GMMHMM.analyze_trained_gmmhmm(model, int_to_label, scaler, feature_keys, feature_weights, raw_averages=None)[source]

Analyzes the trained GMMHMM model to describe state characteristics. Calculates weighted average means for easier interpretation.

Parameters:

  • model (hmm.GMMHMM) – The trained GMMHMM model.

  • int_to_label (dict) – Dictionary mapping state indices to labels.

  • scaler (StandardScaler) – The scaler fitted on the multi-feature data.

  • feature_keys (list) – List of feature names in the correct order.

  • feature_weights (np.ndarray) – NumPy array of weights applied to features.

  • raw_averages (dict, optional) – Dictionary containing raw feature averages by label

Returns:

Dictionary containing model analysis information

Return type:

dict
